faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kashipur Library Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIM Kashipur Library Apprentice position is 14th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Library Apprentice post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Library and Information Science with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent grade from a recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Library Apprentice position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Library Apprentice post is 30 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Library Apprentice role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10,000/- per month for the Library Apprentice position.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Library Apprentice position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Library Apprentice role will involve an interview, which can be conducted either in person or online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIM Kashipur Library Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIM Kashipur Library Apprentice recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job for the Library Apprentice post?
faq.answer: The job for the Library Apprentice position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. In which state is IIM Kashipur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kashipur is located in Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Library Apprentice recruitment is LA-01/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIM Kashipur Library Apprentice recruitment must be submitted online only.
